title: Consumer goods and services to COICOP 1999 classes
statement: Assign the COICOP 1999 class (for example 01.1.1 Bread and cereals) to the description of a good or service bought by a household, as recorded in a price collection or a household expenditure diary.

generation.context: Item descriptions are recorded by price collectors and in household expenditure diaries.
rules: Write each description as a price collector or a household diary would record it: two to ten words, often in capitals, with abbreviations, quantities, sizes, or the kind of outlet, and usually without a brand name.
Vary the goods and services within each class, the formats (single items, packs, per kilogram, per visit, per month), and the wording.
Do not give the list one pattern: mix short and long forms, and leave most of them without an added qualifier.
Each description must belong to the class it is given under the explanatory notes above, and must not fit another class from the list better.

reference.source: ONS consumer price inflation item indices (December 2024, August 2019) and consumption segments (September 2026), with the COICOP class ONS assigned, under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Built by build.py.
